column1: # Curated RepBase family -> (repFamily, repClass) for MOUSE.
# WHY (-475.43): B1 and B2 are the major mouse SINEs but UCSC has no bare 'B1' or
# 'B2' repName -- the instances are B1F, B1_Mus1, B2_Mm1a and so on -- so the
# RepBase consensus parents resolved to nothing and each became its own counting
# family. B1's subfamilies alone carry 108 Mb.
# DERIVATION, and it is NOT the rejected longest-prefix rule of 475.42. That rule
# went child -> parent (MER21 -> MER2) and was wrong 18 times in 161. This one goes
# PARENT -> CHILDREN: for an unresolved family X, collect every rmsk repName that
# EXTENDS X, and adopt their annotation only if all of them agree. Disagreement
# rejects the entry outright, which is what makes it safe -- on hg38 ground truth
# the same rule scores 44/47 at min_kids=1 and 28/29 at min_kids=2, so it is used
# here as EVIDENCE FOR A CURATED TABLE, never as an automatic fallback.
# Every row below was additionally cross-checked against the family's own RepBase
# CLASS token (ERV1/ERV2/ERV3 -> LTR, SINE1/7SL -> SINE, L1 -> LINE, ...):
# Not reference-derived -- mouse has no reference -- so unlike
# hg38.repbase-class-family.tsv this file is not circular.
# Columns 4 and 5 are evidence, ignored by the reader: how many rmsk subfamilies
# agreed, and how many genome bases they cover across mm10+mm39.
